## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Confirmations: mixed sector returns (Tech, Energy, Healthcare positive while Financials and Consumer Discretionary are negative) and large-cap divergence — AAPL (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +15.58%) ABOVE TREND vs MSFT (1W: -2.11% | 1M: +3.08%) TREND EXHAUSTION and JPM (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -3.49%) BELOW TREND.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Technology leads: NVDA (1W: +8.66% | 1M: +14.92%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +15.58%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +10.70% | 1M: +60.47%) ABOVE TREND. Energy/Healthcare follow: XOM (1W: +1.94% | 1M: +1.56%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Utilities, Financials and Consumer Discretionary are lagging: VST (1W: -9.91% | 1M: -13.03%) BELOW TREND and CEG (1W: -14.84% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND in Utilities; WFC (1W: -8.04% | 1M: -9.49%) BELOW TREND in Financials; BKNG (1W: -7.90% | 1M: -14.40%) BELOW TREND in Consumer Discretionary.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: PANW (1W: +24.01% | 1M: +40.97%) ABOVE TREND; CVS (1W: +12.95% | 1M: +27.51%) ABOVE TREND; F (1W: +12.91% | 1M: +8.11%) ABOVE TREND; TSLA (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +22.26%) ABOVE TREND; MNST (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +14.47%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: ROST (1W: -7.49% | 1M: -5.16%) BELOW TREND; BKNG (1W: -7.90% | 1M: -14.40%) BELOW TREND; RCL (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -6.16%) BELOW TREND; WFC (1W: -8.04% | 1M: -9.49%) BELOW TREND; CRM (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Consumer Discretionary and pockets of Tech/Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Top 1W movers: PANW (1W: +24.01% | 1M: +40.97%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +12.95% | 1M: +27.51%) ABOVE TREND, F (1W: +12.91% | 1M: +8.11%) ABOVE TREND; watch FCX (1W: +10.30% | 1M: -1.41%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL. Major divergence present (MSFT TREND EXHAUSTION, AMZN TREND EXHAUSTION, META POTENTIAL REVERSAL) — watch for trend break; treat momentum as tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Tech is mixed but relatively strong on the week: NVDA (1W: +8.66% | 1M: +14.92%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +15.58%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND — internal rotation between big-cap AI leaders and lagging enterprise names; sector 1W: +1.25%.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials are under pressure: WFC (1W: -8.04% | 1M: -9.49%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -3.49%) BELOW TREND while V (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +3.08%) ABOVE TREND — breadth negative and leadership mixed, so prefer selectivity.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare shows selective strength: UNH (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND, while JNJ (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -4.03%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — sentiment-positive catalysts (LLY, JNJ) are supporting recent outperformance but watch recall/earnings risk at ISRG (-80 news).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective leaders showing confirmed strength such as UNH (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.66% | 1M: +14.92%) ABOVE TREND and TSLA (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +22.26%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to structurally weak names like WFC (1W: -8.04% | 1M: -9.49%) BELOW TREND and technology laggards ACN (1W: -8.55% | 1M: -16.14%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear Growth vs Value leadership — remain selective and monitor divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +24.01% | 1M: +40.97%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +10.70% | 1M: +60.47%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: WFC (1W: -8.04% | 1M: -9.49%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND, ROST (1W: -7.49% | 1M: -5.16%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Technology and Healthcare (both showing pockets of leadership and headline catalysts); Energy as tactical given XOM (1W: +1.94% | 1M: +1.56%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Financials and Utilities where breadth is weak and headline-driven volatility can persist.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Monitor NVDA (1W: +8.66% | 1M: +14.92%) ABOVE TREND — a sustained move above recent highs would confirm continuation; watch AAPL (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +15.58%) ABOVE TREND — hold of the monthly trend needed to keep leadership; WFC (1W: -8.04% | 1M: -9.49%) BELOW TREND — a breakdown below recent lows would confirm further downside pressure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
LLY (+80): Newly approved drugs headline; LLY (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. CSCO (+55): AI orders lift outlook; CSCO (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +23.31%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. JNJ (+55): Wall Street optimism on drug pipeline; JNJ (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -4.03%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — bullish news but 1M still negative, monitor for follow-through. AMZN (+50): AI search overhaul; AMZN (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +8.48%) TREND EXHAUSTION — sentiment positive but near-term price lag.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
ISRG (-80): FDA Class I recall headline — monitor for execution and flow-through (price divergence to watch). COF (-55): earnings miss flag; watch for consumer credit stress. CVX (-45): analyst downgrade; CVX (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -0.55%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — sentiment bearish and 1M slippage suggests follow-up risk. ROST (-40): margin pressure headline; ROST (1W: -7.49% | 1M: -5.16%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed (no clear Growth or Value leadership).  
UNH (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.66% | 1M: +14.92%) ABOVE TREND and PANW (1W: +24.01% | 1M: +40.97%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: major large-cap divergence (MSFT TREND EXHAUSTION, AMZN TREND EXHAUSTION, JPM BELOW TREND) and mixed news sentiment (LLY bullish vs ISRG very bearish) — monitor for trend confirmation.
